nodes.text: Er... I mean, that's what some people might say...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But don't you want the chance to tell your side of the story?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Just doin' my job, son. Just doin' my job.

nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Er... I mean, that's what some people might say...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But don't you want the chance to tell your side of the story?
Clearly you're...

nodes.text: What? What's that supposed to mean?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Er... What I mean is... You're part of the show!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: We chose you because we've been watching you enforce skateboard laws and...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I... Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Officer Monte, you've just been 'Pranked'!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: This week's wacky episode is 'Who Wants to Enforce Skateboard Laws'! Right, girls?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah! What do you think this video camera is for?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: We chose you because we've been watching you enforce skateboard laws and...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What? What's that supposed to mean?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Er... What I mean is... You're part of the show!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: We chose you because we've been watching you enforce skateboard laws and...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well... You see... It's not what it looks like.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh, this ought to be good...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: How can I talk my way out of this one? What's a good reason why a bunch of kids would be at the school with a skateboard and a camera?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Aha! That's it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's true. We were skating...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Aha! You admit it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But we were skating because we're filming a new TV show!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Let me explain...
You're our...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, you see... What we're doing here is...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: `RUN RUN RUN!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]RUN RUN RUN![/i][/color]

nodes.text: An hour later...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That guy just doesn't give up! We've been running all over town!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I told you we shouldn't have run away!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I... I think we finally lost him.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You can't escape the law!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Time to run!
Two hours later...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Okay, I don't see any sign of him.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Thank goodness! That was close...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's getting late... I need to turn in my video soon.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Then we'd better get back to the school and edit it!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Just what do you kids think you're doing here?! Skateboarding on school property?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: When I'm done with you, the only board you'll be skating by is the parole board!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh...
Kim turns to Spike and whispers...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Let's get out of here...
Mallika whispers back...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Running away never solved anything.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No, getting arrested never solved anything!

nodes.prompt: No, getting arrested never solved anything!

menu.text: No, getting arrested never solved anything!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Mallika is right. That scout is going to be collecting a lot of videos. If I want to get noticed, I'm going to need to stand out.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Spike, I think this is ridiculous.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, it's my video, Kim, and I say we're going for a stunt off the statue.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Fine... But I wish you'd listen to me.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: We came to the school, didn't we? That was your idea.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess that's true.
Spike heads over to the statue.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Here I go!
Spike gets a running start and skates up the tail of the lizard statue!
Then he jumps off of the nose!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay... I'll admit it... That does look cool.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Thanks.
Spike does a few more tricks while the girls film...
Suddenly, there are flashing red and blue lights!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You kids stop right there!
Spike skates up to the officer.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What seems to be the problem, officer?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Kim is right. The scout is looking for solid skateboarding tricks, not flashy gimmicks.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Exactly! Okay, the camera is ready... Go do your stunt!
Spike heads over to the stairs.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Here I go!
Spike jumps down the stairs...
And crashes into a policeman!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A skateboarder, eh?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Spike! Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm fine... But I think we've got bigger things to worry about...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh... Right...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Stairs, handrails, and statues... What else could a skater ask for?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: This should be good...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: As long as we don't get caught...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: We `won't!` So what should we start with? How about a jump over the stairs?
nodes.text_bbcode: We [color=#3b78e2][i]won't![/i][/color] So what should we start with? How about a jump over the stairs?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Maybe you could do a trick off of the statue of the Centerscore mascot! It could be a statement against the establishment!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: This isn't some kind of social commentary... It's a skate video!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Who says it can't be both?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Besides, it would make an interesting trick. How many other skaters have a giant lizard statue to jump off of?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But Spike would be able to do a more impressive trick if he went for the stairs!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: This might make or break my video... I've really got to figure out what will look better to the scout. What should I pick?

nodes.prompt: I've really got to figure out what will look better to the scout.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I've really got to figure out what will look better to the scout.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: We haven't filmed very much, and the scout will mainly be looking at the tricks.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh... Right.
After the girls film a few more tricks...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, I think we've got enough footage now. It's not great, but I guess it'll work.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Maybe we should have filmed at the school...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sorry, Spike... I guess it wasn't a good idea to come here.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, if we don't end up having enough impressive tricks to put in the video, we'll know who to blame.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Maybe we could still do some more filming once we get back to the school?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You said you needed to finish this by the end of the day... We just don't have time to set up at another location.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Get out of the shot, Kim!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, let's get some footage of Spike gazing out at the ocean.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Like this?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Perfect!
Later...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Now look morose...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I can do that.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh, cruel world of skateboarding!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Nice!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: This... This is ridiculous.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay... I think we have enough of that.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'll say.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hmm... What you said gives me an idea. We should get some slow, contemplative close-ups!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What does that have to do with skateboarding?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It'll show his depth! His personality! Skateboarding is more than a sport... It's a way of life!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... But the video is supposed to show his skateboarding.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike? What do you think your video needs?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What would be better for the video? I really need to make the right decision.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I think I'll...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Here goes...
Spike skates off...
And crashes right into the palm tree!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Ouch...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Spike! Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oww...
Kim and Mallika help Spike up.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm okay, I'm okay.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That ankle doesn't look so good, Spike. I knew this was a bad idea! You should have listened to me!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm fine... But I shouldn't have tried that trick. Now all we've got is footage of me crashing!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm so sorry, Spike...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, this is skateboarding... People get hurt all the time.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's a risk you take when you jump on the board.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Don't worry... I've had worse falls.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Now, what should we film next?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh. Sorry. I guess I don't know that much about skateboarding.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Obviously.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Don't be too hard on Mallika... Skateboarding is about pushing the boundaries... Taking risks.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Of course, it's also about knowing when a trick won't work... Like skating up a palm tree has all kinds of problems.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean we should stop thinking of new tricks.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: If no one ever tried new tricks, we'd still be skateboarding in a straight line down the sidewalk, right?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Ah, isn't the beach beautiful?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah... Because `that's` our main goal in filming a skate video... Making sure it's `pretty.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... Because [color=#e23b3b][i]that's[/i][/color] our main goal in filming a skate video... Making sure it's [color=#e23b3b][i]pretty.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Aesthetics are important in film. You'd know that if you ever took a minute to think about the composition of the shot!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sorry, while you're analyzing the composition...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'll be over here making a skate video.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Come on, Spike. We'd better get started.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Okay... Let's get some tricks on camera. Um... Maybe I can skate over on that sidewalk?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You mean where the kids are rollerblading? Or where the cart is selling fish and chips? There's almost no space to skate around here!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Spike, I told you we should have gone to the school!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Kim's right... It's going to be hard to find a good place to skate... I really should have gone to the school. I hope this doesn't hurt my video too much.
A little while later...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, we've got some usable footage... Maybe we should try something different.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Like what? I've got to do something good to impress the scout.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: How about trying to skate up that palm tree?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What?! That's a terrible idea!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, let's hear what Spike has to say about it! It's `his` video!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, let's hear what Spike has to say about it! It's [color=#3b78e2][i]his[/i][/color] video!

nodes.prompt: How about trying to skate up that palm tree?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: How about trying to skate up that palm tree?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Nice! This has kind of a 'Be Angry with the Institution' vibe to it.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It does seem to fit...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I had my doubts, but I agree...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: My... My ears!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Make it stop!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: This didn't really turn out the way I thought it would...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You know, silence isn't all that bad...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah... I think it might be better to leave the audio track out of this.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I guess I've already spent too much time trying to get this to work... I don't want to keep the scout waiting.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Good idea.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Okay, no audio track then.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Now let's pick out what soundtrack we should use. I've got some great songs by 'Iron Dirigible'.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: 'Iron Dirigible'? Are you serious? We need something like 'Deathcrab for Booty'.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, why don't we try making our own soundtrack? This computer has that 'Garage Gang' program on it. We can layer some different instruments...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Let me take a look at it...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I don't know... That sounds hard...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Wow, it sounds like `someone` isn't being very supportive.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, it sounds like [color=#3b78e2][i]someone[/i][/color] isn't being very supportive.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I was just trying to be realistic!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... I think I know how this program works...
Spike opens 'Music Maker' and starts putting a song together...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Good call!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I... I guess it's your video, Spike.
Kim puts the finishing touches on the editing.
She plays the video...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Awesome! That looks great!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Mallika might not be too happy with me right now, but I know this was the right move for the video.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You won't regret it.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's your video, Spike, but I think you're making a mistake.
Mallika puts the finishing touches on the editing.
She plays the video...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: The black and white makes it kind of hard to see what's going on...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But... The obscurity is part of the beauty!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I told you we should have done it my way!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Great... this doesn't look right, `and` Kim's mad at me! But there's no time to fix it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Great... this doesn't look right, [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] Kim's mad at me! But there's no time to fix it.

nodes.text: Spike, Kim, and Mallika sit down in front of the film club's computer.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Let me import the footage we just filmed...
Kim hooks the camera up to the computer and transfers the footage.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Now we just need to pick the clips that we're going to use.
Kim marks the clips and lines up the best of the footage.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Wow... Kim's really good at this!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, so the basic outline of the film is done... But we should talk about what style you want to use for the transitions.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I was thinking we could use smash cuts. You know, to really go for the jarring, gritty feel of an edgy film.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, I think we should use soft fades. It'll make a nice contrast with the skating.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I don't know about that... Don't you think it'll slow down the pace of the video?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I bet it'll make the skating look even faster by comparison.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh! We could even change the color settings to show the whole thing in black and white! That always makes films look artistic and classy.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No way! We should add special effects! I could do some cool tricks with the footage...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Stop trying to take over the video!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Girls, stop fighting! This isn't about which one of you is right! This is about making a good video!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Exactly! And `her` way of doing it would ruin everything!
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! And [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color] way of doing it would ruin everything!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike, you're going to have to choose which one of us to side with.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Okay, it's time to focus... This is about the video. What's going to look better?

options.label: Soft fades and black and white.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's really `our` video. Mallika and I made it for him.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's really [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] video. Mallika and I made it for him.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I loved that girly 'Skateboarder Boy' song. That was a nice touch... And the footage you mixed in of the kittens.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: But I'll never know how you got Spike to wear that pink dress with all the ribbons...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What? I never did that!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You'd be amazed what you can do with special effects.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Heh. I can't believe these girls talked you into making the worst skate video ever.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh, I wouldn't say we had to talk him into it.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah... It was more like watching him dig his own grave.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: The two of you... You intentionally sabotaged my video?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: The next time you ask people to help you with something, remember that they're doing you a `favor!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The next time you ask people to help you with something, remember that they're doing you a [color=#3b78e2][i]favor![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I couldn't have said it better myself.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: I'd just like to thank you girls for giving all of us skaters some quality entertainment.
Spike is the laughing stock of the skate park!
How could you do this to him? This is just cruel...
You'd better try this episode again! And this time, try not to ruin Spike's life!

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sorry, I forgot Mallika had decided to make our video `boring.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, I forgot Mallika had decided to make our video [color=#3b78e2][i]boring.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Please don't fight...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Artistic doesn't mean boring!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Special effects don't make it an action movie!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Quit fighting!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I really need to get this video finished and turn it in!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But we were just...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: The two of you have been arguing all day, and I'm sick of it! The talent scout could be leaving the skate park any minute!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You girls need to stop being so impossible! Don't you understand how important this is?!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well... I guess I didn't realize that all of `our` hard work was making it difficult for you to finish `your` video.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... I guess I didn't realize that all of [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] hard work was making it difficult for you to finish [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] video.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Don't worry, Spike... I think we know just the thing...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Good... Let's hurry up and finish it.
After a few hours...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, I guess we're done.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Finally! I've got to hurry to get this to the scout!
A short time later...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh no! The skate park is deserted!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey! Is anyone here?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Spike? What are you shouting for?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Skazz! I can't believe I'm actually happy to see you. Where's the talent scout?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: That guy? He took off hours ago! Are you just bringing your video to him `now?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That guy? He took off hours ago! Are you just bringing your video to him [color=#e23b3b][i]now?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! You're `way` too late! I guess you blew your big chance!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha ha! You're [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too late! I guess you blew your big chance!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Man... What a waste of time.
One week later...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, Spike! We heard that you didn't make it in time to give the scout your video.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's okay... Who needs the FLEX-Games anyway?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Speaking of your skate video... Mallika and I came down here today because we wanted to tell you something.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: We didn't want all of our hard work making the video to go to waste... So we put it up on 'Yootube'!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey, Spike! I saw your video yesterday. In fact, everyone at the skate park has been watching it!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Why don't we do something funny? Maybe something that also shows how you had help... What do you think of 'Skate Minds Think Alike'?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Definitely 'Skate Minds Think Alike'. It's funny. It's cool... Just like you, Kim.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tee hee...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Here, Spike. I'll show you how to add a title.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That looks great!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, I guess you two don't really need me...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I guess I should have realized that the two of you would rather work on this alone!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Mallika...
Mallika runs off!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sob!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I guess I've been siding with Kim more than I've been siding with Mallika... I should have been more careful.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Poor Mallika... I hope she's okay.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But I guess I need to finish this video.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: This video is going to be great now that old 'Killjoy Mallika' is gone.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'll throw in some special effects... Tweak the transitions...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Are you sure that's a good idea?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Don't worry... With my help, we'll get this done in no time!
And so Kim works on the video... And after an hour, it's done!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That should do it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Thanks! Now I just need to drop this off with the scout...
A short time later...

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: Hey, man. I've got my skate video.

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: Very good. Thank you, Spike.

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: I'll be reviewing the videos I've gotten today and issuing invitations in a week.
One week later...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, Spike! Have you heard from the scout yet?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No... Believe me, when I do, you'll be the first to know.
Just then, Spike's phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: Spike! I just finished watching your video.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You did?

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: The production quality was amazing!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks. And the skating?

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: Skating?

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: Look, Spike, I'll cut to the chase. I didn't see much skating in that video.

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: But I did love all of those special effects! I've talked to the production team, and we want the person who made that video to film the FLEX-Games.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You mean... You called for Kim? Not for me?

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: That's the idea, kid.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What's wrong, Spike? Does he want to talk to me?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I... I guess so...
Spike hands the phone to Kim.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yes? Hello?

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: How would you like to jumpstart your film career by working for the FLEX-Games?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Professional film work while I'm still in high school? That sounds amazing!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: When do I start?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Kim... That's my cell phone...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Kim?
Things worked out pretty well for Kim...
Too bad you were supposed to be helping Spike!
Maybe if you had done a better job, the video just might have gotten the scout's attention!
There's only one way to find out... And that's giving this episode another try!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Definitely 'Skate Expectations'. It's classy... It's clever... Just like you, Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Tee hee...
Mallika pushes Kim aside and goes to the computer.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Here, Spike. I'll show you how to add a title.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That looks great!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, maybe we should add a special effect to the title...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No, Kim. I don't think that would fit the tone of our video.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What if we tried...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No, Kim. That isn't a good idea.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You didn't even let me finish!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I don't know why I bothered to help if you aren't even going to listen to me.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm out of here.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Kim...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I guess I've been siding with Mallika more than I've been siding with Kim... I should have been more careful.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Jerk!
Kim runs off!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yikes...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Kim sounded really mad... But I guess I don't have time to worry about her... I need to finish this video.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Relax! I'm going to make this video the way it was meant to be made.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Don't worry... With my help, you'll be skating in the TEXT-Games in no time!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... It's called the FLEX-Games...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah! That one...
Mallika works on the video... And after an hour, it's done!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: See? That didn't take long.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Thanks! Now I just need to drop this off with the scout...
A short time later...

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: Hey, man. I've got my skate video.

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: Very good. Thank you, Spike.

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: I'll be reviewing the videos I've gotten today and issuing invitations in a week.
One week later...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, Spike! I've got some great news!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What's up?
Just then, Spike's phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: Spike... I just finished watching your video.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You did?

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but you're just not what we're looking for in a FLEX-Games skater.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Huh? What did I do wrong?

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: Look, Spike, I'll cut to the chase. Our skaters are expected to be tough... Professional... And... Cool.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Are you're saying I'm not cool enough to be in the FLEX-Games?!

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: I'm not saying that. You're 'cool' in your own special way, Spike. I'm sure the indie film kids love you.

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: But you just don't have the edge that we're looking for.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I... I understand.
Spike hangs up the phone.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That was the talent scout... Looks like they aren't going to give me an invitation to the FLEX-Games...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That's too bad...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But this might cheer you up!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I submitted our video to the 'Moonprance Film Festival'!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And it was accepted!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Congratulations?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: After everyone sees you in this deep, contemplative video, you'll be famous in the indie film world!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Umm... That's good... I think?
Maybe Spike can have a career in the independent film circuit...
But it looks like he can forget about any chance at a professional skateboarding career...
If you don't want to leave Centerscore High's skateboarder in this predicament, you better give this episode another try!

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait, I still want to add some special effects.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Special effects? Stop trying to make this into some kind of action movie.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Girls...
You made a good video, but you didn't land a perfect score!
If you try again, there just might be a bonus scene waiting at the end of a perfect game...

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: Just keep your skating skills sharp... You'll need them. We'll see you and your friend Skazz next month at the games.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Skazz got a spot in the FLEX-Games too?

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: That's right! Isn't that great?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: Anyway, we'll be seeing you!
The scout hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Congratulations!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Looks like all of our hard work really paid off!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Thanks for all your help, girls. I really owe you.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well... How about taking me out to dinner?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey! Spike should take `me` to dinner!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! Spike should take [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] to dinner!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But Spike and I really have chemistry together...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike and I have chemistry too! And we have history together!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Spike's known me longer than he's known you!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Look, girls. I don't want to sound like a jerk...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But I'm not really looking for a relationship right now.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You two are both awesome. I'd be lucky to date either one of you!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But if I'm going to be in the FLEX-Games, I've got to spend all of my free time practicing.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: As much as it kills me to say it, I think the best thing for both of you is to forget all about me for now.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh... Well... I understand.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah... Good luck with your skateboarding.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: See you girls later.
It took some quick thinking and some smart playing, but you helped Spike make a great skateboarding video!

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: I won't lie... I didn't really get that artistic style... But the video overall was good.
Just then, Spike's phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: Spike, I was really impressed by your video!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: Yes! I can tell you're really going to make your mark in the skating world. It would be my pleasure to offer you a spot in the FLEX-Games!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I think that's it.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: We've done all we can...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Then I'd better hurry up and give this tape to the scout!
A short time later...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, man. I've got my skate video.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Very good. Thank you, Spike.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'll be reviewing the videos today and issuing invitations in a week.
One week later, Spike sees Kim and Mallika after school...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, Spike! Have you heard from the scout yet?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No... Believe me, when I do, you two will be the first to know.

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Almost... We still need a title.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Right. How about something classical but with a humorous twist? Maybe something that reflects the deeper meaning behind skateboarding as well.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: How about 'Skate Expectations- Spike's Skateboarding Journey'?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: So... I guess we're done?
Spike, Kim, and Mallika sit down in front of the film club's computer.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Let me import the footage we just filmed...
Kim hooks the camera up to the computer and transfers the footage.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Now we just need to pick the clips that we're going to use.
Kim marks the clips and lines up the best of the footage.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Wow... Kim's really good at this!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, so the basic outline of the film is done... But we should talk about what style you want to use for the transitions.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I was thinking we could use smash cuts. You know, to really go for the jarring, gritty feel of an edgy film.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, I think we should use soft fades. It'll make a nice contrast with the skating.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I don't know about that... Don't you think it'll slow down the pace of the video?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I bet it'll make the skating look even faster by comparison.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh! We could even change the color settings to show the whole thing in black and white! That always makes films look artistic and classy.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No way! We should add special effects! I could do some cool tricks with the footage...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Stop trying to take over the video!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Girls, stop fighting! This isn't about which one of you is right! This is about making a good video!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Exactly! And `her` way of doing it would ruin everything!
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! And [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color] way of doing it would ruin everything!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike, you're going to have to choose which one of us to side with.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Okay, it's time to focus... This is about the video. What's going to look better?

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Guess you're trying to snag an invite today.

nodes.text: And I could really use that prize money to help my mom out.

nodes.text: Yeah... I think I left the camera running... But why?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What if we layer some of his interview on top of the music?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, I've seen that done in a lot of artistic videos...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And it'll really add tension...

nodes.text: All done.

nodes.speaker: Mallika

nodes.speaker: Kim

nodes.speaker: Kim

nodes.speaker: Mallika

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But sometimes the journey is more important than the destination. And today's journey was a little too demoralizing.

nodes.text: I won't lie... The style of the video was a nice touch.

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: Plus, your tricks were solid.

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: That trick off the lizard statue... Brilliant!

nodes.speaker: Man2
nodes.text: I didn't really get that part where you stared out at the ocean and contemplated the human condition... But maybe that's what the kids are into these days.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So are you going to give up now?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hah! `You` should be the one giving up.

nodes.text: This isn't over, Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Nicole was right about you...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What?! What did Nicole say about me?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: She said that you'd try to steal my guy!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I don't know what happened between you and Spike, but he's not your boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Not like it would matter to you if he were!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I don't know what Nicole told you, but it's not like that.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm not going to believe anything you say, Kim.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Fine! Don't believe me. But you should understand one thing...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm not backing down.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: If you want to prove Nicole wrong, you should stay away from Spike!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I like him! Is that a crime?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It is because `I` was with him first!
nodes.text_bbcode: It is because [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] was with him first!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: If you were with him, why aren't you dating him now?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Because... Well...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Because you already had your chance, and he doesn't want to date you!

nodes.speaker: Kim

nodes.text: When that happens, I'll be waiting.
